regressions.scope: Current v16 regression commands, ordinary colony and controlled temperature scripts keep their individual stated boundaries.

failedAttempts.scope: Default broad concurrency and one browser-overlapping run exceeded a housing test deadline; one run also hit Vitest onTaskUpdate RPC timeout. Final quiet full run passed with clean exit; no timeout increase or assertion removal.
Main-renderer startup briefly had a null snapshot. Wait now requires an available snapshot; final both-mode run passed.

The first six cycles passed, then the old layout audit attempted to click the correctly research-locked TreeSowing control. The audit now checks its disabled reason and retains visibility/occlusion checks. Complete lifecycle and viewport rerun passed.

limitations: Natural adult Human only; no armor absorption, ranged weapons, social-fight suppression, native instant-kill protection, stun, permanent scars, infections, implants, genes or age-dependent health scaling.

Ordinary raid campaign reached sternum/ribcage/tibia injury and normal care, but did not amputate a limb. Hand loss and eye injury used an explicitly controlled UI fixture; no claim about normal amputation incidence.
20 TPS and 12000-tick project days are retained; native time conversion and deterministic keyed RNG do not reproduce Unity random sequences or float bits.
Hearing/talking/eating capacities are calculated, but absent social and surgery systems are not implied. Low-level applyInjury intentionally bypasses the damage workers in controlled tests.
Browser changes use real controls with read-only state observations, not a screen-only agent. Three-colonist campaigns do not establish large-population or long-term balance.

Six same-document save/new/load cycles verify bounded renderer resource convergence only. Main-page isolate heap excludes workers, native allocations and GPU memory; no long-duration leak or whole-browser capacity claim.
